    Job description

    This is an opportunity to join a cutting-edge start-up that’s redefining automotive perception technology, fresh off a funding round, they’re well-capitalized! They are looking to hire an experienced SoC Design Lead to spearhead the development of high-performance, low-power System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions, with a strong focus on DSPs and GPUs.

    This is a unique opportunity for a highly motivated a    ...nd technically skilled leader to shape the future of cutting-edge SoC architecture and design. You will build and lead a world-class engineering team while ensuring compliance with automotive industry standards, including functional safety requirements.

    Key Responsibilities
    • Build and lean a new team of engineers - fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
    • Architect and design high-performance, low-power SoCs from concept to production.
    • Collaborate closely with design houses and external partners to drive successful SoC development.
    • Optimize SoC performance through in-depth analysis of CPU, GPU, and system-level microarchitectural features and workloads.
    • Ensure compliance with automotive industry standards, including functional safety requirements, throughout the development lifecycle.

    Key Requirements
    • Proven experience in SoC architecture and design, with a focus on DSPs and GPUs.
    • Strong technical background in low-power and high-performance semiconductor design.
    • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and manage high-performing engineering teams.
    • Expertise in microarchitectural analysis, optimization, and performance benchmarking.
    • Experience working with external design partners and SoC development teams.
    • Familiarity with automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262) and compliance requirements.

    🌎 Bay Area CA or Boston MA

    More job highlights

    Job description

    Summary
    Posted: Oct 9, 2024

    Role Number:200572353

    Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient processor, system-on-chip (SoC). You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly    ... and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining this group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, you and your team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices. Imagine what you could at Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, inspiring, and innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it.

    The SOC Emulation team is looking for a strong engineer to join our team focusing on the creation, deployment and support of advanced emulation environments. In this highly visible role, you will be at the center of a chip design effort collaborating with all disciplines, with a critical impact on getting functional products to millions of customers quickly.

    Description

    Description
    As a member of the team, you will be involved in:
    - SoC bringup on emulation, root cause failing SoC/Processor tests and emulator environment issues
    - Support multiple Emulation environments using the latest emulation techniques:
    - C/C++ DPI Transactors, SV assertions, Coverage, Power Estimation, SpeedBridges, Accelerated UVM Testbenches
    - Close collaboration with Design, DV, Power, Silicon Validation, Performance and Software teams. Strong design, debug, communication and teamwork skills are essential
    - Work with the top tier emulation vendors to improve capabilities, debug issues

    Minimum Qualifications

    Minimum Qualifications
    • Emulation experience on any/all available platforms (Palladium, Protium, Veloce, or Zebu, EP) including design bringup, build flow, debug, performance and throughput tuning.
    • Hands-on experience writing scripts using any languages (Perl, Python, Makefile)
    • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience.

    Key Qualifications

    Key Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with UVM verification environments
    • Design verification, DFT, TestBench modeling experience
    • Experience with C/C++, DPI and System Verilog, Verilog, VHDL design.
    • Experience with waveform debug tools, Verdi/SimVision
    • Knowledge of communication/Interface protocols, like (PCIE, USB ), DDR, SPI.
    • Strong communication skills and ability to work as a team.

    Education & Experience

    Education & Experience

    Additional Requirements

    Additional Requirements

    Pay & Benefits

    Pay & Benefits
    • At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,800 and $312,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

    Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits.

    Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.
